name: plaud-import
description: Import an audio file into Plaud (web.plaud.ai), generate the transcript and summary, read the summary and export the transcript as a file. Run it in a session with a profile signed in to Plaud, with timeout_sec 900 (generating takes minutes). The tenant needs Plaud's export host in BROWSER_TENANT_DOWNLOAD_ALLOW. Labels as Plaud's web app showed them in October 2026 (the export steps checked against it with 0.14.1): check the steps against a read of the page before the first run.

file_name.description: its name as Plaud lists it: the uploaded filename without the extension

steps.note: a profile that is not signed in lands on the login page and stops here
Import audio opens the file chooser
the upload is done once the file shows up in the list
the list offers Generate for the new file only after it is loaded again
a long recording takes longer; the read below still gets what is there
the export icon: a button with no name, the first one after Share
Plaud's export menu also offers audio, notes and the mind map
